source.detail: Advantage+ Shopping/App Campaigns can no longer be created or updated

spec_evidence.checked: Release notes in DB raw excerpt verified against the facebook-nodejs-business-sdk v25.0.0 release: ASC and AAC campaign creation/update via the Marketing API is withdrawn starting v25.0, extending to all versions by 2026-05-19, as part of Automation Unification toward the streamlined Advantage+ setup. Legacy metrics (Page Reach, Impressions, 3-second Viewers) are additionally slated for deprecation in June 2026.

fix.migration_guide: This is a platform capability withdrawal, not an API surface rename: Advantage+ Shopping and App Campaign objects can no longer be created or updated through the Marketing API at all. The sanctioned path is the streamlined Advantage+ setup, which restructures campaign objects and settings - choosing how to map existing ASC/AAC campaigns onto the new setup is an advertising-strategy decision per account. No codemod can produce that mapping; only a human migration of the campaign structure applies.
fix.example_after:
// Advantage+ Shopping campaign creation via Marketing API is withdrawn in v25.0.
// Migrate to the streamlined Advantage+ setup; campaign structure mapping requires a human decision.
